m1.typescript: m1 a sound design passes review with no findings

e1.typescript: e1 a design without a feedback loop or a stage is rejected

e2.typescript: e2 autonomy is flagged only when the path is known

e3.typescript: e3 several agents need independent parts and no shared context

e4.typescript: e4 an unapproved write is a finding only when an audit is needed

e5.typescript: e5 output that nobody validates is flagged

e6.typescript: e6 findings are ordered by severity then rule and the verdict follows the worst

e7.typescript: e7 the cheapest design that is not rejected wins and ties go by name

wrong-no-feedback-check.defect: never reports a design without a feedback loop

wrong-input-stage-skipped.defect: does not require an input stage

wrong-autonomy-always.defect: flags every agent design, whether or not the path is known

wrong-team-shared-only.defect: flags a team only for a shared context and not for parts that depend on each other

wrong-team-single-agent.defect: applies the team rule to a design with one agent

wrong-write-without-audit.defect: flags an unapproved write even when no audit is needed

wrong-validate-inverted.defect: flags output that has a validation step and not output that lacks one

wrong-order-by-rule.defect: orders the findings by rule name and ignores severity

wrong-any-finding-rejects.defect: rejects a design for a medium finding

wrong-rejected-allowed.defect: lets a rejected design win on price

wrong-tie-by-position.defect: breaks a price tie by list position and not by name
